audit.whatIsWrong: diff said HARD while diffRating said 4/10, breakdown.difficulty said 4/10 and report[14] called it a 'Favoured matchup' — against a 45.56% win rate over 180 games.
audit.why: The page told the reader in one place that the lane is hard and in three others that it is favoured. The chart itself (full and content agree row-for-row: Heim, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Heim, Kayle, Kayle) matches HARD, so the ratings were the wrong half.
audit.corrected: diffRating 4/10 -> 7/10, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] rewritten to a losing matchup, tldr and report[2] restated around the real swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet defect: sequencingCues 0) and no ability names besides Divine Judgment.
audit.why: 'Bait her R' is unusable without the price of the bait. Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s, Celestial Blessing a flat 15s, Starfire Spellblade 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Radiant Blast 12s at rank 1 — the 160s rank-1 ultimate is why baiting it once wins the whole level-6 window.
audit.corrected: 160s/80s written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid, spikes[1], whys[3], the trading block and report[5]; Celestial Blessing and Starfire Spellblade named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields told the reader Divine Judgment 'blanks' the CH-3X stun and that popping it makes the whole combo whiff.
audit.why: Riot's text grants INVULNERABILITY — a damage effect. It stops the grenade's damage; it does not stop the stun from applying. The practical advice inverts: you still get the lockdown, so you bait the ultimate out and spend your burst on the second window rather than assuming your engage is wasted.
audit.corrected: Restated as damage immunity in mid, spikes[1], whys[3], report[5] and wants.foe[2]: the stun lands, the damage does not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in itemization but never justified; Celestial Blessing was never named.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal. Her W is a flat 15s heal that undoes exactly the chip a turret nest deals, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Celestial Blessing's 15s and the Grievous Wounds reason written into breakdown.late and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle was referred to as 'he'/'his' in six fields.
audit.why: Inherited template text. Fixed alongside the substantive edits.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and the mirrored report entries.

edits.before: This is your window and you have to cash it. With three turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade you own the lane — land the center-stun as she steps up for a melee last-hit and the turret beams plus W rockets delete a chunk of her bar before she reacts. At 6, UPGRADE!!! into a super-turret or a wider grenade can outright kill a still-melee Kayle, but respect her R: if she ults the instant you commit, your burst is wasted on invulnerability, so bait the R or stun her cleanly first. The lane is TRICKY because every plate and kill you steal here is the only currency you'll have once she hits second form.
